title: LetGo Band telemetry
description: Both payload types that cross a tier boundary. band_window travels band to gateway over BLE. cloud_daily_summary travels gateway to cloud over mTLS. A record is one or the other, never both.

schema_version.description: Payload contract version. Bumped on any breaking field change. A receiver rejects a version it does not know rather than ignoring unknown fields.

child_ref.description: Pseudonymous enrolment reference. Never a name, never a date of birth. The map to a real child stays inside the facility.

hmac_sig.description: HMAC-SHA256 over the payload, hex encoded, or the literal placeholder used in mock data. A receiver drops anything it cannot authenticate.

clip_state.description: Strap state machine state. See spec.md section 3.

strap_event.description: null in the normal case. Carries a transition when the strap state changes. BREAKAWAY, CUT and FAULT are the strap breach class and are sent unbatched, ahead of any queued feature window.

attendance_state.description: Attendance state machine state. See spec.md section 4. The gateway holds the authoritative copy.

activity_features.description: Features extracted on the band. Raw IMU samples are never represented here and never leave the band.

mean_accel_mag.description: Mean acceleration magnitude over the window, in g.

accel_variance.description: Variance of acceleration magnitude over the window.

step_count.description: Steps segmented on the band during the window.

cadence_spm.description: Steps per minute during the window.

posture_est.description: Posture estimate for the window. The vocabulary is not fixed yet, see OPEN-QUESTIONS.md question 2.6.

band_window.title: Band to gateway, per feature window
band_window.description: Emitted once per window_s over BLE. Carries extracted features and strap state, never raw samples.

device_id.description: Band identity. Facility-local, and forbidden in the cloud payload.

ts.description: Band-reported window end time, UTC. The gateway also timestamps on receipt, because band clocks drift.

window_s.description: Length of the window these features summarise. A calibration parameter, see spec.md section 6.

strap_closed.description: Circuit continuity. true means closed, which means worn. The strap circuit is the authority on wear, and no classifier output can contradict it.

battery_pct.description: Remaining charge. Drives the battery critical escalation, which fires before depletion.

rssi_dbm.description: Link quality, used to separate radio dropout from removal. Forbidden in the cloud payload, because it leaks position within the facility.

confidence.description: On-band segmentation confidence for this window. Below the confidence floor the Safeguard suppresses and logs rather than guessing.

fw_version.description: Firmware provenance, so a bad version can be traced through the audit log.

seq.description: Monotonic per device. Orders windows and detects gaps.

cloud_daily_summary.title: Gateway to cloud, per child per day
cloud_daily_summary.description: The only payload that leaves the facility. additionalProperties is false so that any disallowed field is rejected structurally at ingest. Forbidden here: raw motion in any form (activity_features), location (rssi_dbm), per-window data (window_s, per-window ts, per-window confidence), trend flags, device_id, clip_state, strap_event, and version provenance. Data minimisation is enforced by this schema rather than by policy.

facility_id.description: Which facility. Needed for multi-site administration.

check_in.description: Time the two-condition attendance rule was satisfied, UTC.

check_out.description: Time of the staff tool release that ended the session, UTC. null if the day ended without one.

active_minutes.description: Daily total. Not a series, and not resolvable to any part of the day.

movement_variety_index.description: Single figure for the day, 0 to 1. Formula not yet specified, see OPEN-QUESTIONS.md question 2.2.

anomaly_events_resolved.description: A count. Not which anomaly, not when it happened, not what the strap state was.

gateway_id.description: Which gateway sent it, for certificate and revocation purposes.

seq.description: Monotonic per gateway. With date, this is the replay protection.
